speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound results showing thickening of the bile ducts and focal dilatation, combined with your elevated alkaline phosphatase and negative viral serologies, strongly suggest Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, this is a classic association. Does your itching worsen at night, and have you noticed any pale, clay-colored stools?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The physical exam findings of scleral icterus and multiple scratch marks confirm significant cholestasis. Given the ultrasound showing bile duct thickening and your history of ulcerative colitis, do you have any family history of liver or bowel disease, or have you undergone any recent endoscopy?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
